verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is an AI-native game engine and hosted platform that runs servers, publishing and analytics, so outbound event webhooks are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Agents reading analytics or running publishing through MCP/CLI is pull-based tooling, not event subscription, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
